views.name: v_user_message_received
views.query:

views.name: v_llm_response
views.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `test-project.agent_analytics.v_llm_response` AS
SELECT
  timestamp,
  event_id,
  event_type,
  agent,
  session_id,
  invocation_id,
  user_id,
  trace_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.response') AS response,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.prompt') AS INT64) AS usage_prompt_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.completion') AS INT64) AS usage_completion_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.total') AS INT64) AS usage_total_tokens,

  CAST(JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.usage_metadata.tool_use_prompt_token_count') AS INT64) AS usage_tool_use_tokens,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.usage_metadata.cached_content_token_count') AS INT64),CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.prompt') AS INT64)) AS context_cache_hit_rate,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(latency_ms, '$.total_ms') AS INT64) AS total_ms,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(latency_ms, '$.time_to_first_token_ms') AS INT64) AS ttft_ms,
  JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.model_version') AS model_version,
  JSON_QUERY(attributes, '$.usage_metadata') AS usage_metadata,
  JSON_QUERY(attributes, '$.cache_metadata') AS cache_metadata,
  JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.cache_type') AS cache_type,
  JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.finish_reason') AS finish_reason
FROM
  `test-project.agent_analytics.agent_events`
WHERE
  event_type = 'LLM_RESPONSE'

views.name: v_event_compaction
views.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `test-project.agent_analytics.v_event_compaction` AS
SELECT
  timestamp,
  event_id,
  event_type,
  agent,
  session_id,
  invocation_id,
  user_id,
  trace_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS start_seconds,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS end_seconds,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_start,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.compacted_content') AS compacted_content
FROM
  `test-project.agent_analytics.agent_events`
WHERE
  event_type = 'EVENT_COMPACTION'

  invocation_id,
  user_id,

  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS start_seconds,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS end_seconds,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_start,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.compacted_content') AS compacted_content
FROM
  `my-proj.example:p.my_ds.events tbl`
WHERE
  event_type = 'EVENT_COMPACTION'

views.name: v_event_compaction
views.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `proj.agent_analytics.v_event_compaction` AS
SELECT
  timestamp,
  event_id,
  event_type,
  agent,
  session_id,
  invocation_id,
  user_id,
  trace_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS start_seconds,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS end_seconds,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_start,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.compacted_content') AS compacted_content
FROM
  `proj.agent_analytics.agent_events`
WHERE
  event_type = 'EVENT_COMPACTION'

  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,

views.name: v_event_compaction
views.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `test-project.agent_analytics.v_event_compaction` AS
SELECT
  timestamp,
  event_id,
  event_type,
  agent,
  session_id,
  invocation_id,
  user_id,
  trace_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS start_seconds,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS end_seconds,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_start,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.compacted_content') AS compacted_content
FROM
  `test-project.agent_analytics.agent_events`
WHERE
  event_type = 'EVENT_COMPACTION'

views.name: v_event_compaction
views.query:

  agent,

  user_id,
  trace_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS start_seconds,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS end_seconds,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_start,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.compacted_content') AS compacted_content
FROM
  `test-project.agent_analytics.agent_events`
WHERE
  event_type = 'EVENT_COMPACTION'

views.name: v_llm_response
views.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `proj.ds.v_llm_response` AS
SELECT
  timestamp,
  event_id,
  event_type,
  agent,
  session_id,
  invocation_id,
  user_id,
  trace_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.response') AS response,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.prompt') AS INT64) AS usage_prompt_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.completion') AS INT64) AS usage_completion_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.total') AS INT64) AS usage_total_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.usage_metadata.cached_content_token_count') AS INT64) AS usage_cached_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.usage_metadata.thoughts_token_count') AS INT64) AS usage_thinking_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.usage_metadata.tool_use_prompt_token_count') AS INT64) AS usage_tool_use_tokens,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.usage_metadata.cached_content_token_count') AS INT64),CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.prompt') AS INT64)) AS context_cache_hit_rate,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(latency_ms, '$.total_ms') AS INT64) AS total_ms,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(latency_ms, '$.time_to_first_token_ms') AS INT64) AS ttft_ms,
  JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.model_version') AS model_version,
  JSON_QUERY(attributes, '$.usage_metadata') AS usage_metadata,
  JSON_QUERY(attributes, '$.cache_metadata') AS cache_metadata,
  JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.cache_type') AS cache_type,
  JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.finish_reason') AS finish_reason
FROM
  `proj.ds.tbl`
WHERE
  event_type = 'LLM_RESPONSE'

views.name: v_event_compaction
views.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `proj.ds.v_event_compaction` AS
SELECT
  timestamp,
  event_id,
  event_type,
  agent,
  session_id,
  invocation_id,
  user_id,
  trace_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS start_seconds,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS end_seconds,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_start,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.compacted_content') AS compacted_content
FROM
  `proj.ds.tbl`
WHERE
  event_type = 'EVENT_COMPACTION'

  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS start_seconds,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS end_seconds,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_start,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,

FROM
  `proj.ds.tbl`
WHERE
  event_type = 'EVENT_COMPACTION'

views.name: v_llm_response
views.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `proj.ds.v_llm_response` AS
SELECT
  timestamp,
  event_id,
  event_type,
  agent,
  session_id,
  invocation_id,
  user_id,
  trace_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.response') AS response,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.prompt') AS INT64) AS usage_prompt_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.completion') AS INT64) AS usage_completion_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.total') AS INT64) AS usage_total_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.usage_metadata.cached_content_token_count') AS INT64) AS usage_cached_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.usage_metadata.thoughts_token_count') AS INT64) AS usage_thinking_tokens,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.usage_metadata.tool_use_prompt_token_count') AS INT64) AS usage_tool_use_tokens,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.usage_metadata.cached_content_token_count') AS INT64),CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.usage.prompt') AS INT64)) AS context_cache_hit_rate,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(latency_ms, '$.total_ms') AS INT64) AS total_ms,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(latency_ms, '$.time_to_first_token_ms') AS INT64) AS ttft_ms,
  JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.model_version') AS model_version,
  JSON_QUERY(attributes, '$.usage_metadata') AS usage_metadata,
  JSON_QUERY(attributes, '$.cache_metadata') AS cache_metadata,
  JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.cache_type') AS cache_type,
  JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.finish_reason') AS finish_reason
FROM
  `proj.ds.tbl`
WHERE
  event_type = 'LLM_RESPONSE'

  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS start_seconds,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS end_seconds,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_start,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.compacted_content') AS compacted_content
FROM
  `proj.ds.agent events`
WHERE
  event_type = 'EVENT_COMPACTION'

  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS end_seconds,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_start,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.compacted_content') AS compacted_content
FROM
  `proj..`
WHERE
  event_type = 'EVENT_COMPACTION'

views.name: v_event_compaction
views.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `proj.ds.v_event_compaction` AS
SELECT
  timestamp,
  event_id,
  event_type,
  agent,
  session_id,
  invocation_id,
  user_id,
  trace_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS start_seconds,
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6) AS end_seconds,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.start_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_start,
  SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(SAFE_MULTIPLY(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp') AS FLOAT64), UNIX_MICROS(SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(JSON_VALUE(content, '$.end_timestamp'), r'(\.\d{6})\d+', r'\1') AS TIMESTAMP)) / 1e6), 1000000) AS INT64)) AS window_end,
  JSON_QUERY(content, '$.compacted_content') AS compacted_content
FROM
  `proj.ds.tablé_ü`
WHERE
  event_type = 'EVENT_COMPACTION'
